title: A VAL argument is evaluated in the row context of the call
query: DEFINE FUNCTION Twice = ( x : NUMERIC VAL ) => x * 2
EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS ( Product, "Product", Product[Product], "Twice", Twice ( Product[Price] ) )

source.quote: a val parameter is evaluated eagerly before entering the function body, and therefore inherits both the row context and the filter context of the caller
source.supports: the argument is evaluated in the row of the caller

source.quote: UDFs can be used in a calculated column to apply reusable logic to every row in a table.
source.supports: the page passes a column of the current row to a function

derivation: In each row Product[Price] is evaluated before the call: 100, 20, 10, 50. The body doubles it. A fixed decimal times an integer is a fixed decimal.
